title: write-good-lint.py — Python replica of eight write-good Vale rules
purpose: Reusable single-file linter implementing the detection logic for all eight write-good rules documented in art_01M6JYTD4PWJ0G1JBGM1Z6QXQR r1 (Passive, Weasel, TooWordy, ThereIs, So, E-Prime, Illusions, Cliches). Levels match the source table. Designed as a report-only tool — no automatic rewrites — consistent with the source's guidance that the repeated-word 'edit/truncate' action should be left unapplied to preserve author choices. Run as CLI: python write_good_lint.py <file.md>
